Як говорити про минуле, якого не було: я: How to talk about a past that didn’t happen: if I had left earlier, I would have made it. Plus mixed conditionals, where the past affects the present: if I had slept enough, I wouldn’t be so sleepy now.
Третій тип: уявне минуле, якого насправд: Third conditional: an imagined past that didn’t really happen
Якби я вийшов раніше, я встиг би на авто: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus.
Жаль або докір за минуле: Regret or criticism about the past
If you had told me, I would have helped.
Можливий результат у минулому: could hav: A possible result in the past: could have / might have
Якби ми забронювали раніше, можливо, отр: If we had booked earlier, we might have got better seats.
Змішаний тип: минула умова, результат за: Mixed type: past condition, result now
Якби я більше спав, зараз не був би таки: If I had slept more, I wouldn’t be so tired now.
Змішаний тип: постійна умова зараз, резу: Mixed type: permanent condition now, result in the past
Якби Макс не був такий сором’язливий, ві: If Max weren’t so shy, he would have spoken to her at the party.
If + had + V3, would have + V3. Обидві ч: If + had + V3, would have + V3. Both parts are about the past.
Заперечення: hadn’t + V3 у частині з if,: Negative: hadn’t + V3 in the if part, wouldn’t have + V3 in the main part.
Питання в головній частині: What would y: Questions go in the main part: What would you have done if ...?
Минуле → зараз: If + had + V3, would + V: Past → now: If + had + V3, would + V (often with now, today, still).
Зараз завжди → минуле: If + Past Simple,: Always true now → past: If + Past Simple, would have + V3.
Скорочення ’d буває і had, і would. If I: The short form ’d can mean had or would. If I’d known, I’d have come = If I had known, I would have come.
Українське «якби я знав» не перекладаємо: Don’t translate “if I had known” word by word as If I would have known. After if we use had + V3, and would have lives only in the main part.
У would have, could have, might have діє: In would have, could have, might have the verb is always in the third form: gone, seen, done. The form from the second column (went, saw) is a mistake here. And we write have, not of, even though they sound similar.
Результат зараз: would + V, а не would h: Result now: would + V, not would have
Якщо наслідок минулої події відчуваємо з: If we feel the result of a past event now (now, today, still), the main part has would + V. Would have + V3 is only for a result in the past.
Шпаргалка: усі типи поруч: Cheat sheet: all types side by side
Нульовий, перший і другий типи вже знайо: The zero, first and second conditionals are already familiar, they are here only for comparison. The key sign of the third conditional: had + V3 after if and would have + V3 in the main part. Table: type, if part, main part, example.
Раунд 1. Форми: had done і would have do: Round 1. Forms: had done and would have done
Уявне минуле: у головній частині would h: Imagined past: the main part has would have + V3, here negative: wouldn’t have missed. Wouldn’t miss and didn’t miss don’t express “if back then”.
У частині з if третього типу стоїть had: The if part of the third conditional has had + V3: had studied. We don’t put would here.
Результат у минулому, якого не було: wou: A past result that didn’t happen: would have + V3 = would have got. Had got only goes in the if part.
Після if у третьому типі had + V3: had a: After if in the third conditional: had + V3 = had asked. Asked would make it a second conditional, and we don’t put would after if.
Would have + V3. Третя форма від come та: Would have + V3. The third form of come is the same: come, so would have come, not would have came.
Минула умова, якої не було: had + V3 = h: A past condition that didn’t happen: had + V3 = had checked. Checked and has checked don’t show an imagined past.
Had + V3: see → saw → seen, тому had see: Had + V3: see → saw → seen, so had seen. Had saw is wrong.
Матч уже в минулому, тому would have + V: The match is already in the past, so would have + V3: would have won. Would win is about the present or future.
Головна частина третього типу: would hav: Main part of the third conditional: would have + V3. Eat → ate → eaten.
Would have + V3: seen. Saw це друга форм: Would have + V3: seen. Saw is the second form, it can’t follow have.
Після if третього типу had + V3: had cha: After if in the third conditional: had + V3 = had charged.
Would have + V3: bought. Had had не поми: Would have + V3: bought. Had had is not a mistake: the first had is the auxiliary, the second is the V3 of have.
Головна частина: would have + V3 = would: Main part: would have + V3 = would have booked.
Торт уже спечений, умова в минулому: had: The cake is already baked, the condition is in the past: had followed. We don’t put would after if.
Частина з if може стояти другою, правило: The if part can come second, the rule is the same: had + V3 = had known.
Пікнік був у минулому: would have been c: The picnic was in the past: would have been cancelled. Would be is about the present.
Тільки в першому реченні had + V3 після: Only the first sentence has had + V3 after if and would have + V3 in the main part. The others have mistakes: came, knew and would after if.
Would have + V3. Run у третій формі не з: Would have + V3. Run doesn’t change in the third form: run → ran → run.
Магазин був зачинений у минулому: would: The shop was closed in the past: would have got. Had got only goes after if.
Had + V3: take → took → taken. Had took: Had + V3: take → took → taken. Had took is wrong.
Negative in the if part: hadn’t + V3. Forget → forgot → forgotten.
Головна частина третього типу із запереч: Main part of the third conditional, negative: wouldn’t have + V3. Hadn’t dropped only goes after if.
Питання про уявне минуле: would + підмет: A question about an imagined past: would + subject + have + V3 = would you have done.
Після if hadn’t + V3: hadn’t eaten. Didn: After if: hadn’t + V3 = hadn’t eaten. Didn’t eat doesn’t fit, because this is an imagined past.
У питанні частина з if та сама: had + V3: In a question the if part stays the same: had + V3 = had invited. We don’t put would have after if.
Головна частина із запереченням: wouldn’: Negative main part: wouldn’t have + V3 = wouldn’t have closed.
Would have + V3, а V3 від forget це forg: Would have + V3, and the V3 of forget is forgotten. Forgot is the second form.
Last night показує минуле: would you hav: Last night shows the past: would you have got. Would you get is about the present or future.
Умова в минулому з запереченням: hadn’t: A negative past condition: hadn’t + V3 = hadn’t played.
Фінал уже був: wouldn’t have + V3. Hadn’: The final has already happened: wouldn’t have + V3. Hadn’t reached is only for the if part.
Питання: would + you + have + V3. Go → w: Question: would + you + have + V3. Go → went → gone, so would you have gone.
Минуле, якого не було: would have got we: A past that didn’t happen: would have got wet. Got means it really happened.
Wouldn’t have + V3 у головній частині: w: Wouldn’t have + V3 in the main part: wouldn’t have finished.
Сукня була дорогою тоді, у минулому: had: The dress was expensive then, in the past: hadn’t been. We don’t put wouldn’t have after if.
Після if hadn’t + V3: lose → lost → lost: After if: hadn’t + V3. Lose → lost → lost, so hadn’t lost.
Порядок у питанні: would + підмет + have: Word order in the question: would + subject + have + V3. The other options are missing have, have the wrong order or have no V3.
Умова з запереченням: hadn’t + V3 = hadn: A negative condition: hadn’t + V3 = hadn’t barked.
Yesterday показує, що результат у минуло: Yesterday shows the result is in the past: wouldn’t have been. Wouldn’t be would be about now.
Уявна минула умова із запереченням: hadn: An imagined negative past condition: hadn’t forgotten. Didn’t forget would make it a second conditional.
У питанні частина з if не змінюється: ha: In a question the if part doesn’t change: had + V3 = had rained.
Now показує результат зараз: змішаний ти: Now shows a result in the present: mixed type, would + V = wouldn’t be. Wouldn’t have been is about the past.
Умова в минулому (last year), результат: Condition in the past (last year), result now (now): would + V = would have. Here have means “own”, not the auxiliary.
Минуле рішення, результат зараз: змішани: A past decision, a result now: mixed type, would live (or would be living).
Страх висоти постійний, це правда і зара: The fear of heights is permanent, it’s still true now: mixed type, If + Past Simple = weren’t. We don’t put would after if.
Минула умова, наслідок зараз (now): woul: Past condition, result now (now): wouldn’t be.
Реальна умова в майбутньому (tomorrow):: A real condition in the future (tomorrow): first conditional, will + V. There’s no reason for would have here.
If + Past Simple про уявне теперішнє: др: If + Past Simple about an imagined present: second conditional, would + V = would drive.
Усе в минулому (yesterday): третій тип,: Everything is in the past (yesterday): third conditional, would have watched.
Кошеня взяли в минулому, а тихо чи гамір: The kitten was adopted in the past, and whether the flat is quiet or noisy is about now (now): mixed type, would be.
Переїзд був у минулому: hadn’t moved. Ре: The move happened in the past: hadn’t moved. The result is now, so the main part has wouldn’t know.
Yesterday: умова в минулому, тому had to: Yesterday: the condition is in the past, so had told. Told would make it a second conditional about now.
If I were you: уявна ситуація «на твоєму: If I were you: an imagined situation, “in your place”. This is a mixed type: were + would have said. People also say was in conversation.
Перемога в минулому, фінал зараз (now):: The win was in the past, the final is now (now): mixed type, would be.
Third conditional, everything is in the past: hadn’t + V3. Fall → fell → fallen.
Обери змішане речення (минуле впливає на: Choose the mixed conditional (the past affects the present).
Змішаний тип: had + V3 після if і would: Mixed type: had + V3 after if and would + V with now. The second sentence is first conditional, the third is second, the fourth is third.
Last night: результат у минулому, третій: Last night: the result is in the past, third conditional. Sleep → slept → slept.
Загальний факт: нульовий тип, Present Si: A general fact: zero conditional, Present Simple in both parts. Would is not needed here.
Last week: умова в минулому, тому had lo: Last week: the condition is in the past, so had lost. The result is now, so would be.
Right now: результат зараз, змішаний тип: Right now: the result is now, mixed type. Would be skiing, not would have been.
Ten years ago і now: минула умова, тепер: Ten years ago and now: past condition, present result. Would + V = would be.
Раунд 4. Пастки: would після if і компан: Round 4. Traps: would after if and friends
Після if had + V3, у головній would have: After if: had + V3, in the main part: would have + V3. Would after if, would of and calls after have are mistakes.
Пастка: хочеться сказати would have call: Trap: you want to say would have called, but after if only had + V3.
Після would have завжди V3: called. Call: After would have we always use V3: called. Call, calling and to call are impossible here.
Give → gave → given. Після have потрібна: Give → gave → given. After have we need the third form: given, not gave.
Головна частина: wouldn’t have + V3. У б: Main part: wouldn’t have + V3. In British English the V3 of get is got, in American English gotten.
Після if у третьому типі стоїть had: If: After if in the third conditional we use had: If I had known. Would never comes after if.
Перед have + V3 у головній частині стоїт: Before have + V3 in the main part we use would: I would have stayed. Had have doesn’t exist.
Would is already there, have + V3 is missing: have won. Would won without have is wrong.
Find the sentence without a mistake.
Would have + V3: would have helped. Of з: Would have + V3: would have helped. Of instead of have is a mistake: would’ve just sounds like would of.
Be → was / were → been. Після if had bee: Be → was / were → been. After if: had been, not was and not would have been.
Now: результат зараз, тому would (not) +: Now: the result is in the present, so would (not) + V: wouldn’t be sitting. Wouldn’t have sat is about the past.
Had + V3 від have = had had. Подвійне ha: Had + V3 of have = had had. The double had is correct here.
Після if had + V3: had caught. Would hav: After if: had + V3 = had caught. Would have caught in the if part is a typical mistake.
Yesterday: результат у минулому, would h: Yesterday: the result is in the past, would have + V3. Know → knew → known.
Had seen і would have stopped: обидві ча: Had seen and would have stopped: both parts use had / have + V3. Had saw, no had or no have are mistakes.
Уявне минуле: had been. Was дало б други: An imagined past: had been. Was would make it a second conditional, and we don’t put would after if.
Вечірка вже минула: would have been. Гол: The party is already over: would have been. The main part can come first, and then no comma is needed.
Фільм уже подивилися: would have enjoyed: The film has already been watched: would have enjoyed. Had enjoyed only goes after if.
Головна частина третього типу із запереч: Negative main part of the third conditional: wouldn’t have cooked.
Насправді він промок, ми уявляємо інше м: In reality he got soaked, we are imagining a different past: wouldn’t have got.
Насправді забула, тому уявна умова: hadn: In reality she forgot, so this is an imagined condition: hadn’t forgotten.
Навчання в минулому, читання зараз (now): Studying was in the past, reading is now (now): mixed type, would read. If I had = If I had studied.
Насправді було зачинено: уявна минула ум: In reality it was closed: imagined past condition, had been.
Автобус запізнився в минулому: hadn’t be: The bus was late in the past: hadn’t been. Wasn’t would make it a second conditional, and we don’t put would after if.
Прослуховування вже було: would have + V: The audition has already happened: would have + V3 = would have got.
Подія вчора, наслідок зараз (now): зміша: The event was yesterday, the result is now (now): mixed type, would + V = would have. Would have had would be about the past.
Had + V3. Put у всіх трьох формах однако: Had + V3. Put is the same in all three forms: had put.
Мова про той момент у минулому: had know: We are talking about that moment in the past: had known. Knew would make it a second conditional about now.
Last Sunday: результат у минулому, would: Last Sunday: the result is in the past, wouldn’t have lifted. Hadn’t lifted only goes after if.
Прогулянки не було в минулому: had walke: The walk didn’t happen in the past: had walked. The boredom is now, so wouldn’t be.
Ситуація вже минула: would have given. W: The situation is already over: would have given. Would give is about the present.
Лягав спати в минулому: had gone. Сонлив: Going to bed was in the past: had gone. The sleepiness is now, so would be in the main part.
Зустріч минула: would she have said. Wou: The meeting is over: would she have said. Would she say would be about an imagined present.
Холод був учора: hadn’t been. Wasn’t не: The cold was yesterday: hadn’t been. Wasn’t doesn’t express an imagined past.
Це реальна подія, без if: had to take. W: This is a real event, with no if: had to take. We use would have taken only for an imagined past.
Рослини засохли в минулому: wouldn’t hav: The plants died in the past: wouldn’t have died.
Фільм уже подивилися: wouldn’t have watc: The film has already been watched: wouldn’t have watched. Hadn’t watched only goes after if.
Куртку не взяла в минулому, мерзне зараз: She didn’t take a jacket in the past, she’s freezing now (now): mixed type, wouldn’t be.
